notes: Build answers from the Vault Guide now come as tidy build cards with Copy buttons. Tap 'Copy build' to copy the whole build as clean text — title, aura and exilus, mods in mod-screen order, arcanes, and the play note — and paste it anywhere: your notes, a message, or chat. 'Copy compact' gives a one-line version for quick sharing. Warframe itself only creates build links in-game, so there is no import code — the card lists the mods in order so slotting them in takes seconds.
